description: Ministry of Buddasasana Religious and Cultural Affairs - Appoint Archaeology Advisory Committee
categorisation: The gazette content is a government notification that names a specific individual (Dr. Hiniduma Sunil Senevi, Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs) and vests the power to act in him by his ministerial title. It then details his action of appointing members to a specific committee (the Archaeology Advisory Committee), which constitutes a description of a specific responsibility and action taken. This satisfies the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3): it contains both "who" (a named government person) and "what" (a detailed administrative action and responsibility being exercised).
